purpose: D4 diversity stress test: 8 hobbies chosen to exercise the new deterministic diversity layer (protagonist presentation, scene structure, lighting/palette, emotional mode, effect intensity) on top of the unmodified D4 house style plus the three localized recipe fixes (books.reading text leak, wellness.cold_plunge cold-vs-warm drift, sports.skateboarding footwear silhouette). This test does NOT revalidate D4 itself - the question is whether the same D4 rendering language can produce visibly diverse presentation without losing semantic fidelity or brand identity.
prior_rounds: catalog/style_d4_durability_12_v1.json (D4 12-card cross-category durability test, found the 3 localized defects fixed this round)

collecting.stamps.why: Deterministic profile for this id is male_led. Indoor, object-collection subject, not previously tested in the 12-card set, gives a clean read on whether the diversity layer can shift the protagonist away from the default young-female presentation without breaking semantic correctness.

sports.golf.why: Deterministic profile for this id is older_adult, a category the D1-D4 and 12-card durability rounds never explicitly tested. Outdoor sport, wide environmental framing, tests whether an older protagonist still reads as an energetic hero-moment subject under D4.

outdoors.fishing.why: Deterministic profile is object_led + object_hero, a double stress on de-emphasizing the human figure in favor of the fishing gear/catch moment - tests whether D4's hero-moment focal hierarchy still reads as a special-illustration key visual without a dominant human face.

music.violin.why: Deterministic profile is blue_hour (cool dusk lighting), directly stress-testing the lighting/palette dimension against D4's frequent warm/golden default. Indoor solo performance, no equipment-brand-safety risk.

gaming.tabletop_rpg.why: Deterministic profile is small_group, a genuine multi-person social scene distinct from lifestyle.game_nights (12-card set) and gaming.board (D4 6-card set) - different subcategory, different archetype variant, extra check that the group_play archetype stays legible with a night/neon palette.

crafts.pottery_wheel.why: Indoor hands-on craft distinct from crafts.knitting (12-card set), tests mastery emotional mode (confident skill rather than an open smile) plus cool daylight against the creative_studio archetype.

outdoors.mountain_biking.why: Genuine outdoor dynamic-motion action scene (outdoor_motion archetype, untested in prior rounds), female-led protagonist, wide environmental framing - stresses whether D4's hero-moment composition still holds at a wider, more landscape-inclusive frame.

wellness.tai_chi.why: Calm, low-intensity hobby distinct from wellness.cold_plunge (12-card set, now fixed) - tests whether D4's 'heightened special-illustration moment' language still produces a calm, controlled emotional read (mastery, not excitement) rather than forcing artificial energy onto a quiet activity, and whether the calm_wellness archetype avoids any of the sauna/onsen-adjacent safety risk found earlier in this arc.

avoided: none of the 12 durability-test IDs reused (sports.skateboarding, outdoors.kayaking, pets.birds, travel.destination_deep.japanese_onsen_trips, music.piano, wellness.cold_plunge, science.marine_biology, technology.3d_printing, crafts.knitting, books.reading, lifestyle.game_nights, lifestyle.home_decor)
none of the 6 D4 calibration cards reused (business.coworking, entertainment.movie_subgenre.legal_thriller, fashion.streetwear, food.dish.bun_cha, gaming.board, learning.philosophy)

expected.note: Uses the real production compiler with the diversity layer active (diversityProfiles passed to compileHobbyPrompt) plus the three new hobby_overrides_v1.json fixes.

decision_rule.question: Can the same D4 house style produce visibly diverse cards without losing semantic fidelity or brand identity?
decision_rule.if_yes: Keep D4 unchanged, keep the diversity layer, recommend moving toward production-batch architecture. Do not start bulk generation automatically.
decision_rule.if_no: Fix the diversity system, not D4.
